newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil power, telecom sale seen at $79.5 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil power, telecom sale seen at $79.5 bln - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government expects to earn around $79.5 billion from the privatization of the power and telecommunications sectors, a newspaper said.
The electricity sector alone should bring in $50.5 billion in privatization receipts, according to figures from Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), O Globo said.
The government should make at least $29 billion with the telecommunications sell-off, O Globo said.
BNDES President Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros said the privatization of federal telecommunications giant Telebras alone should raise $17 billion, O Globo said.
The sale of long-distance telephone operator Embratel is expected to make another $6 billion and the Band B cellular concessions are also expected to bring in $6 billion.

The sale of federal electricity generators Furnas, Electrosul, Chesf and Electronorte should raise $21.8 billion, with the remaining $28.7 billion coming from the privatization of the federally-owned state power distributors, O Globo said.
--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
